appraisal_events.evidence: elle me comparait toujours à Assuérus : « Et la mort est le prix de tout audacieux / Qui sans être appelé se présente à ses yeux »
appraisal_events.explanation: In her recurring theatrical tease about his house rule requiring her to wait until he rings, Albertine likens the narrator to a king with absolute power over who may approach him, playfully casting him as a figure of domestic authority.

status_effects.explanation: The hyperbolic royal comparison, even if comic, stages the narrator as holding the controlling position in this domestic ritual with Albertine, who must wait to be summoned.
